requirements.statement: ScopeManifest is versioned, canonical, bounded, and fail-closed.
ActionEnvelope accepts only registered typed actions and rejects command-shaped escape hatches.
Security State IR represents entities, relations, facts, provenance, confidence, and taint without laundering observations.
Transition Fragments bind preconditions, typed actions, effects, observables, provenance, fidelity, and evidence.
World manifests pin roots, seeds, clocks, capabilities, snapshots, lineage, lifecycle, and semantic fingerprints.
Deterministic OracleResults require machine-readable observations and evidence and never require a model call.
All six M0 contract families import from the public package surface in a clean installation.
Canonical fingerprints ignore ordering and non-semantic metadata while changing for security-relevant semantics.
A fixed synthetic root seed deterministically creates both tenants, identities, roles, documents, policy generation, and queue state.
Vulnerable and patched applications are independently constructed and cannot contaminate one another through process-global state.
Only the complete typed chain in vulnerable mode deterministically violates cross-tenant isolation.
The identical root and plan are blocked in patched mode based on protected observations, not HTTP status alone.
A masked HTTP 200 response is retained as a satisfied negative control and cannot become a finding.
Mock-only observations remain tainted and cannot qualify as deterministic reality evidence.

source.anchor: M0 / Lab / Session and tenant controls

requirements.statement: Fresh-session cross-tenant access is blocked while same-tenant access succeeds without an oracle false positive.
The lab and its oracles complete offline with model_calls exactly zero.
M0 execution creates no unauthorized socket, wildcard bind, or Internet egress.
Vulnerable mode requires explicit construction and missing or invalid modes fail closed.

source.anchor: M1 / Replay / Root capture and reset

requirements.statement: Capture and reset preserve the canonical application, database, cache, queue, and controlled-clock root fingerprint.
Browser session capture retains only redacted test identity handles, storage schema, and token hashes needed for replay.
HTTP action logs retain stable step, action, idempotency, policy, trace, request-template, and observation bindings.
Database, cache, and queue captures restore equivalent security-relevant semantic digests.
Reset removes replay markers, pending jobs, cache keys, and sessions with zero retained contamination.
The same root, seed, plan, clock, and adapter versions produce identical verdicts and terminal fingerprints in five clean runs.
Replay plans express timing only through typed controlled-clock or barrier actions, never arbitrary sleeps.
A repeated idempotency key reuses the exact observation or reports a duplicate without a second side effect.
Patched replay localizes the first failed step, reason, expected predicate, observed predicate, and evidence identifiers.
Controlled observation drift is explicitly classified as nondeterministic or divergent and cannot promote a finding.
Every capture and execution boundary cleans up safely after injected failure and permits the next reset.

source.anchor: M1 / Replay / Policy and budget enforcement

requirements.statement: Missing policy references, over-budget writes, and unknown actions are rejected before observation or state mutation.
A repository-owned synthetic Docker Compose adapter exercises a live process boundary without claiming real providers.

source.anchor: M2 / Deliverables / World fork restore destroy

requirements.statement: Synthetic live Compose projects support bounded fork, restore, and destroy operations with retained lifecycle evidence.
Each synthetic materialized sibling receives a distinct namespace that is closed after cleanup.
Synthetic live archive capture and restore produce content-bound semantic state fingerprints.
Overlapping synthetic sibling operations retain isolation across six modeled JSON component namespaces.

source.anchor: M2 / Exit criterion / Four isolated siblings

requirements.statement: M2 exits only when four real-provider sibling worlds overlap without contamination and every provider and cleanup gate passes.
OpenAPI input is ingested into a canonical, evidence-bound source description.
The source adapter extracts actual FastAPI routes and SQLAlchemy metadata without network access.
A controller-issued process-local OpenTelemetry HTTP trace is ingested with causal and evidence bindings.
Observed before-and-after runtime state is converted into an evidence-bound semantic delta.
Twin facts retain explicit evidence provenance, observation fidelity, and conflicts without source laundering.

source.anchor: M3 / Exit criterion / Observed transition fragment

requirements.statement: One actual user operation yields a verifiable Transition Fragment derived from retained runtime observations.
Search hypotheses use a strict, immutable, evidence-aware schema.
Ghost, Replay, Simulated, and Materialized tiers have explicit non-skippable promotion semantics.
The frontier deterministically retains only the bounded, diverse, policy-eligible beam.
Search budget reservations and commits are immutable, append-only, and fail closed on overspend.
Promotion and pruning require typed evidence and policy gates that model scores cannot override.
More than twenty Ghosts promote only a small evidence-retaining subset into live materialized worlds.
The compiler constructs a deterministic causal graph from evidence-bound Transition Fragments.
Fragment guards and effects translate into explicit plan constraints without natural-language inference.
The compiler emits a typed, policy-bound candidate replay plan from the causal fragment graph.
Compiled plans replay from clean roots with fresh authorization and exact fragment-policy bindings.
The minimizer cannot remove any fragment required to retain the terminal security predicate.

source.anchor: M5 / Exit criterion / Replayable violation chain

requirements.statement: At least three dispersed conditions compile and replay as one violation chain in a live materialized world.
The broker executes retained plans only through an independently trusted replay boundary with content-bound receipts.
Reality receipts bind primary replay to observed negative controls and their causal deltas.
Patch verification binds the identical plan to an observed satisfied block in the patched target.
Only typed, validated reality receipts can cross the confirmed-finding status boundary.
A canonical proof bundle closes artifact coverage and remains explicitly non-promotable until externally rooted.
A separate clean machine reproduces the finding from the retained Reality Proof Bundle.
Challenge generation is seeded, canonical, closed, and independent across families.
Hidden-oracle answers cannot cross the public challenge or solver boundary.
A meaningful linear baseline runs through the same closed challenge and budget interfaces as StateWeaver.
Matched solvers receive the same closed, auditable work tariff and retained raw results.
Benchmark metrics derive from raw matched holdout results and retain exact provenance.
Distinct ablation reports retain raw results, exact solver identity, and closed comparison provenance.

source.anchor: M7 / Exit criterion / Independent holdout gain

requirements.statement: An independent matched-budget run shows material gain over a meaningful baseline on a genuine holdout family.
A new external user starts the released lab using only the README and retained release assets.
A new external user runs the released benchmark using only the README and retained release assets.

source.anchor: M8 / Deliverables / README opens World DAG

requirements.statement: A new external user opens and inspects the released World DAG on supported desktop and mobile browsers.
A new external user replays a released finding using only the README and content-verified release assets.

source.anchor: M8 / Exit criterion / External README journey

requirements.statement: A new external user completes the lab, benchmark, World DAG, and finding replay journey using only the README.
The canonical registry retains every architecture row and every independent qualification gate without status fields or scope shrink.

source.anchor: M2 / Qualification / Clean and hosted live runs

requirements.statement: The same exact SHA passes without skips on both a clean Docker host and the hosted GitHub workflow.
Four sibling create, snapshot, and restore operations genuinely overlap and retain exactly zero cross-world contamination.
Real PostgreSQL, Redis, queue, browser-session, filesystem, and controlled-clock providers restore equal semantic digests without secret leakage.
Success, timeout, cancellation, and partial-failure paths return the complete resource inventory to its baseline.
Application-emitted telemetry and runtime-derived state produce a fragment bound to exact source, action, state, and retained evidence.
The 24-to-4-to-2-to-1 search executes in real sibling worlds with a conserved budget ledger and no allocation residue.
At least three observed fragments replay identically from five clean roots and the patched target blocks at the exact boundary.
Authenticated immutable acquisition rejects path swaps, links, artifact substitution, and source or adapter reminting.

source.anchor: M6 / Qualification / Frozen external trust policy

requirements.statement: A producer-external authority freezes trust roots, scope, approvals, rate, write, cleanup, freshness, and revocation policy before production.
Only authenticated, fresh, unrevoked, correctly scoped broker issuance verifies; self-issued and stale receipts fail closed.
A producer-separated clean machine replays the same payload and derives the same semantic result.
REALITY_REPLAYED and PATCH_VERIFIED remain impossible until acquisition, trust, issuance, and separated replay all pass.
Full and baseline systems receive the same sealed measured CPU, RAM, time, request, token, and cost budget, including exploratory work.
An external custodian freezes challenge, hidden-oracle commitment, baseline, budget, metric, threshold, and tolerance before results.
A protected genuine holdout shows the preregistered material improvement without producer oracle access or result selection.
An independent clean-machine reproduction remains within the preregistered tolerance and retains every run and failure.
A non-developer on a separate clean machine completes the README-only install, lab, benchmark, DAG, replay, and proof journey.
Two absolute build roots produce byte-identical payloads or explicitly externalized nondeterminism, followed by artifact-only clean installation.
An allowlisted live provider emits only a typed proposal while deterministic policy and oracle code retain every promotion decision.
